name: Onda (Spain)
description: Horizontally divided, the upper half white with a canton of four red pales on yellow and a red cross, the lower half white with four blue wavy stripes.
history: The flag was rehabilitated by resolution of 10 September 2002 of the conseller de Justícia i Administracions Públiques, published in the Diari Oficial de la Generalitat Valenciana no. 4347 of 1 October 2002; it is a flag of 2:3 parted per horizontal half, with four blue waves on white in the lower half; the flag goes back to the chapters agreed between the Order of Montesa and the town of Onda on 15 May 1412.
